title: Lockheed, TTSA and killing the Schumer bill
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Lockheed, TTSA and killing the Schumer bill, about 2017-2023 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Maybe that also explains Robert Weiss, the director of Skunk Works, and his connection to Tom DeLonge and TTSA, To The Stars Academy, later in 2017.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, suggests a link between Lockheed, a large American defense company, and To The Stars Academy, a UFO research company set up in 2017 by Tom DeLonge. He points to Robert Weiss, director of Skunk Works, Lockheed's secret aircraft design division, and his ties to DeLonge's group, and frames it as part of a wider story about efforts to kill a bill from Senator Chuck Schumer on UFO records. If true, it would mean defense industry insiders were shaping the push for UFO disclosure from behind the scenes.
